headline: Fishermans Row, Lykos Isle Trade Strongholds as War Grinds On
war_summary: Since the last edition, the wires have remained hot. Fishermans Row leads the front with four stronghold changes in the last two hours and nineteen in the past day; Hangman's Court and Fort Ember have seen the heaviest traffic. Lykos Isle, quiet earlier, has stirred again with two flips in the last two hours and twenty in the past day, centered on Fort Guile and The Squall. Tempest Island has slowed to no changes in the last two hours but still shows fourteen on the day, with Isle of Psyche and Blackwatch active. Farranac Coast, Godcrofts, and DeadLands have gone quiet on the latest event sheet, though their twenty-four-hour totals remain significant. Weathered Expanse continues to consume casualties on a prodigious scale—tens of thousands in a day—without a recorded change of ownership. On war day 116, no side has reached the thirty-four victory towns required for conquest; the front remains undecided.
